chunks: Regarding the man who emancipates his slave girl, so he makes her emancipation as her dower. Then he divorces her before he sleeps with her. He (peace be upon him) said: ‘She would return to him half of her price. She would have to work with regards to it’.

key_terms.تُسْتَسْعَى: She is asked to work/settled through labor

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a slave girl's manumission if it is used as her dowry and she is divorced before consummation?
ai.summary: This ruling from al-Kafi addresses the specific scenario of 'manumission as dowry' (itq bi-l-mahr), where the slave woman's freedom is treated as the marital gift. The Imam’s directive to return half the value via 'istis'a' (seeking her ability to pay, often through labor) reflects the Shia juristic principle of balancing equity when the full dowry is not yet established by consummation. This highlights the nuanced application of dower laws in cases where the wife is a slave owned by the husband.
